about_the_game:
• Genre: Adventure RPG with life simulator and visual novel elements.

  • Gameplay: Your journey will consist of exploring the world, interacting with numerous unique characters, making decisions, and solving a variety of puzzles. You will also engage in dynamic battles against dozens of enemy types.

  • Progression: The game spans 11 years of the heroes' lives. Each year represents a new chapter with unique events, goals, and challenges. You will develop the characters' skills and strengthen their friendships, which unlocks new dialogues and opportunities.

  • Content: In addition to the main storyline, the world is filled with side quests (50 stories), hidden secrets, and additional activities that significantly increase the overall playtime.

ABOUT THE GAME

Dive into a grand 11-year saga of friendship, adventure, and growing up! This isn't just a game — it's an alternate life in a vast world full of mysteries, dangers, and fun. You'll experience a unique blend of genres: from a fun school life sim to epic battles in a legendary Colosseum.

Together with a team of six inseparable friends, you are about to live through the most vibrant part of life, where every day is a new discovery and every year brings new incredible adventures.

FEATURES

  • A Vast World: Explore over 600 unique locations, from cozy school classrooms to mysterious ancient ruins and their inhabitants.

  • A World Full of Life: Constant hustle and bustle in the school hallways and epic snowball fights that spare no one.

  • Challenging Trials: Battle 150+ types of enemies and defeat 11 legendary bosses in the Colosseum to prove your title of Invincible Gladiator.

  • Multiple Stories: Uncover 50 different stories and solve a sea of puzzles on your journey.

  • One Way Out: Make it to the very end and prove that you are ready to step into adult life.

  • The Ultimate Challenge: Do you dare to face the FIRST GLADIATOR, the one who is absolutely INVINCIBLE? Can you find a way to defeat the undefeatable?

P.S. If anyone can beat him, send me a video of the fight!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: 64-разрядные Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: 4-ядерный CPU, 3.0 GHz (Intel Core i5-4xxx / AMD FX-8300)
  • Memory: 8 GB ОЗУ GB RAM
  • Graphics: Дискретная видеокарта с 2 GB VRAM и поддержкой DirectX 10 / OpenGL 4.4 (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 265)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: Требуется аппаратная поддержка WebGL 2.0
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-разрядная Windows 10 или Windows 11
  • Processor: 4-ядерный CPU, 3.5 GHz+ (Intel Core i5-8600 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600)
  • Memory: 16 GB ОЗУ GB RAM
  • Graphics: Дискретная видеокарта с 4 GB VRAM (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570)

  • VR Support: Установленный последний драйвер для вашей видеокарты
